note: What a server answers a registration with, naming a player in the match and the seat they occupy. It shares its command value with the request it answers, which travels the other way.

fields.name: marker
fields.note: Purpose undetermined. The same three bytes appear in every message of the exchange, in both directions.

fields.name: clientId
fields.note: Which seat in the match the named player occupies, counted from zero.

fields.name: unknown
fields.note: Purpose undetermined. Every message observed carried zeros here, and a client accepted them, so whether it reads them at all is undetermined.
